title: Outgoing-arrow product injective target
statement: For a preordered index set I, a scheme diagram D and a family F of abelian etale sheaves, the target at i is the product over (k,h:i to k) of direct image along D(h.op) of Injective.under(F k). This is a specified construction, not a witness selected from an open existence theorem.

source.place: Product/direct-image system construction in the proof of Tag 0EXZ, with exact inverse image and stage cokernels from Tag 04JC; the compatible injective embeddings of étale coefficient systems portion of the parent stage-diagram proof.

proof_origin.place: Product of direct images over outgoing arrows; P3 second reading specifies the object before separating injectivity from coherence.
